notes:
Primary source: manufacturer product page https://www.portkeys.com/bm7iids/ (fetched via tool; the site returns 403 to direct scripted requests/curl, so content was retrieved through an in-tool fetch that got past that block — treat as best-effort manufacturer data, not a manually-verified render). Cross-checked against retailer ezfilmstore.com (https://ezfilmstore.com/product/portkeys-bm7-ii-ds-7-high-bright-monitor-with-wireless-camera-control/) and CVP.com listing text, which independently agree on: 2x 3G-SDI in, 1x 3G-SDI out (with HDMI cross-conversion), 1x HDMI in, 1x HDMI out, 2-pin LEMO DC input (7.4-24V) and separate 5.5x2.1mm locking DC barrel input (7.4-24V, D-Tap-to-barrel cable included), bottom USB-A port for firmware/LUT loading, and a 3.5mm headphone jack. B&H's own product page (https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1849238-REG/portkeys_bm7_ii_ds_u_7.html) could not be fetched directly (403 Forbidden on repeated attempts) so it was not used as a direct source, though it appeared in search results confirming the same model/URL exists there.

Caveats:
- Neither HDMI input nor output states an HDMI version (1.4 vs 2.0) anywhere in available source text, so grade was omitted for both per instructions.
- SDI grade is explicitly stated as "3G-SDI" for all three SDI ports (2 in, 1 out).
- The monitor also has a dedicated wired "Focus Puller / CAMERA REMOTE" (motor) port for TILTA Nucleus N/M wireless follow-focus control. Its physical connector type (e.g., 2.5mm jack vs. proprietary multi-pin) is not stated on the manufacturer page and could not be confirmed from any accessible source, so it was OMITTED from the ports list rather than guessed.
- The "2-pin LEMO" DC input's connector id was mapped to the closest available option (dc-barrel) since a dedicated locking 2-pin LEMO id is not in the allowed connector list — this is a notable approximation, not an exact match.
- Dual Sony NP-F battery plates (rear, hot-swap) exist but are not a signal/power "port" in the connector sense and were not included.
- 2.4GHz WiFi antenna for wireless camera control is a radio, not a physical cable port, and was not included.
- No confirmation of USB-A speed grade (likely USB 2.0 given its role as a firmware/LUT-loading port, but not stated), so grade omitted.
- Desktop/handheld on-camera monitor — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: DC IN (2-Pin LEMO)
ports.note: Physically a locking 2-pin LEMO-style DC connector, not a barrel jack; closest available connector id used since 2-pin LEMO isn't in the allowed list. 7.4-24V input.

ports.name: DC IN (5.5x2.1mm)
ports.note: Locking 5.5x2.1mm DC barrel input, 7.4-24V, separate from the LEMO input (D-Tap to barrel cable included).

ports.name: USB-A
ports.note: Bottom-mounted USB-A port for firmware updates and loading 3D LUTs from a USB drive; USB speed grade not stated by manufacturer.
